*Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 20 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.d: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

actions.n: Screams of the Past (Wailing Guard Only)
actions.d: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the specter. *Failure:* 7 (2d6) Psychic damage, and the creature's Concentration is broken.
One Undead creature within 5 feet of the specter regains 3 (1d6) Hit Points.

reactions.d: *Trigger:* An ally within 5 feet of the specter is hit by a melee attack roll. *Response:* The target adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

stat.langs: Common (WoW), Darnassian, Forsaken, Orcish, Taur-ahe, Thalassian

traits.d: If Sylvanas is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the save and half damage if she fails. She can't use this trait if she has the Incapacitated condition.
If Sylvanas fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: Sylvanas makes three attacks, using Shadow Dagger or Windrunner's Bow in any combination.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d4 + 7) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage.

*Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d8 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature and doesn't already have a dread wound, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or receive a dread wound. While it has a dread wound, the target loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute or after a spell restores Hit Points to the target.

Sylvanas releases a mournful wail. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature within 60 feet that can hear the wail and isn't a Construct or an Undead. *Failure:* If the target has 50 Hit Points or fewer, it drops to 0 Hit Points. Otherwise, the target takes 45 (10d8) Psychic damage.

bonus.d: Sylvanas teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet.

leg.d: Sylvanas makes one Shadow Dagger or Windrunner's Bow attack.

Sylvanas conjures a 20-foot-radius Sphere of magical Darkness originating from a point she can see within 60 feet, which lasts until the end of her next turn. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22, any creature other than Sylvanas that starts its turn in this area or enters it for the first time on a turn. *Failure:* 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the creature has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. *Failure or Success:* Sylvanas can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

elements.name: Thrall
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (barbarian, orc), chaotic good. Challenge 22.

traits.d: If Thrall fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: Thrall makes three attacks, using Dra'gora or Lava Burst in any combination.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 17 (2d10 + 6) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) damage of a type chosen by Thrall: Cold, Fire, or Lightning.
*Ranged Attack Roll:* +13, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 31 (9d6) Fire damage.

*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 21, one creature Thrall can see within 90 feet. *Failure:* 36 (8d8) Lightning damage, and two bolts of lightning leap from the target to up to two other creatures of Thrall's choice, provided each is within 30 feet of the target; those creatures also make the saving throw, but no additional bolts leap from those targets.

bonus.d: Thrall moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

leg.d: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 21, one creature Thrall can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 36 (8d8) Force damage, and Thrall has Advantage on attack rolls against the target until the end of his next turn. *Success:* Half damage only. *Failure or Success:* Thrall can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.
Thrall makes one Dra'gora or Lava Burst attack.

traits.d: If Kelris fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: Kelris makes three Mind Blast attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Sleep.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.

Kelris casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
*At Will:* Detect Thoughts, Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand, Sleep
*1/Day Each:* Fly, Scrying, Sending

reactions.d:
Kelris casts Counterspell in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
*2/Day:* Counterspell

traits.d: The voidcaller has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: The voidcaller makes two Void Burst attacks.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Force damage.

reactions.d: *Trigger:* The voidcaller takes Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder damage. *Response:* The voidcaller gains Immunity to that damage type (including for the triggering attack) until the start of its next turn.

traits.d: The voidwalker has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
An enemy that starts its turn within 5 feet of the voidwalker has Disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature other than a voidwalker.

actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d4 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the voidwalker regains 3 Hit Points.
